acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of fence-post repair in the East Bay area varies based on several factors, including the extent of the damage, the type of fence post, and the number of posts needing repair. Repairing a single post typically ranges from a few hundred dollars for minor fixes to more for complete replacement, including labor and materials. A detailed estimate from a professional is recommended, as complex situations or specific material choices can affect the final price.
